completion_decisions: The target package is the IET-GWM atmospheric-stability evaluator plus DEEM on all 29 paper-native problem/stability combinations; reported comparison anchors are not separate target algorithms.

No target-paper author code or numeric archive was located; the implementation is independently reconstructed from the primary paper, its direct Gaussian-wake and DEEM predecessors, and a same-Horns-Rev data paper.
The ideal 10x10 grid follows target Figs. 4-6; the Horns Rev 200 m parallelogram grid and digitized arrays are explicitly declared proxies rather than author data.

Target Eq. 13 prints a strict greater-than-five-diameters constraint, but target Fig. 4 uses exactly five diameters; the executable contract therefore uses non-strict at-least-five-diameters spacing and records the conflict.
Target Eq. 8 prints roughness length z0 where the wake predecessor prints reference height z; the target-paper equation takes precedence.
The target omits the physical budget and repeat count; the direct DEEM predecessor supplies 150000 physical evaluations and 30 independent repeats.
The full-core C++ evaluator precomputes state/source/target deficits and DEEM's one-turbine move is updated in O(SN), while sequential active-layout acceptance remains unchanged.
Heavy 504-state Horns runs use one persistent twenty-worker team; light case/seed runs occupy the twenty Waffle cores concurrently without nested oversubscription.

paper.authors: Naizhi Guo and Mingming Zhang and Bo Li and Yu Cheng
paper.title: Influence of atmospheric stability on wind farm layout optimization based on an improved Gaussian wake model
paper.venue: Journal of Wind Engineering and Industrial Aerodynamics

paper_source_conflicts: Target Eq. 13 requires distance greater than 5D while target Fig. 4 contains turbines at exactly 5D.
Target Eq. 8 uses z0 in the Gaussian width expression while the direct wake predecessor uses reference height z.
The target calls the problems grid-based but does not numerically declare either candidate grid.
The target provides plotted probability, power and thrust quantities without machine-readable arrays.
The target omits DEEM's stopping budget and repeat count.

scope.claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of all 29 paper-native problem/stability combinations and predecessor-completed DEEM; not author code, private arrays, exact grid, random state or exact numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.authority: target Eq. 13 and target Fig. 4 conflict resolution
constraints_and_repair.resolution: all turbine pairs must be at least five rotor diameters apart; infeasible DE trials are not counted as physical evaluations

decision_variables.resolution: one integer candidate-grid coordinate per fixed-count turbine

encoding_and_decoder.authority: target paper DEEM description and direct predecessor
encoding_and_decoder.resolution: each turbine is one DE individual and the whole DE population is one active wind-farm layout

initialization.resolution: random feasible placement with at most 200 relocation attempts before a complete restart

metrics_and_repeats.authority: target paper Tables 3 and 5 plus direct DEEM predecessor
metrics_and_repeats.resolution: power, efficiency and COE across all 29 cases for 30 independent repeats

objective_and_direction.resolution: minimize fixed-count Mosetti cost divided by expected farm power, equivalently maximize power for one fixed turbine count

paper_native_cases.resolution: three ideal wind cases times seven stability classes, seven single-stability Horns Rev cases, and one actual Horns stability-distribution case

parameters.authority: target paper Tables 1, 2 and 4 plus cited data source
parameters.resolution: ideal D=40 m, hub=60 m, Ct=0.88, p=0.3u^3; Horns V80 D=80 m, hub=70 m; gamma=0.38; target stability L/z0 tables

stopping_and_physical_fes.authority: direct DEEM predecessor because the target omits both fields
stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: 150000 feasible whole-layout physical evaluations per repeat, including the initialized layout

update_order.authority: target Eqs. 16-18 and direct DEEM predecessor
update_order.resolution: snapshot DE/rand/1 offspring generation with F=0.9 and CR=0.9, followed by in-order random-turbine replacement and sequential active-layout acceptance

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: IET-GWM atmospheric-stability Gaussian deficit, RSS combination, source-specific power and fixed-count COE

wind_and_scenario_sampling.authority: target Figs. 3, 9 and 11 plus Feng and Shen Horns table
wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: ideal A one westward 12 m/s state, B 36 uniform directions at 12 m/s, C digitized 36x3 joint directions and 8/12/17 m/s; Horns 12 Weibull sectors, six speed bins and seven stability classes
